title: Commands: the weather and the time give answers; on Stage a screen opens as a card
tryitout: On Stage with a real script running: “what's the weather” shows a card

steps.why: A weather card on the Agent screen

steps.js: settings.appMode = 'stage'; store.set('settings', settings); openView('dashboard'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); handleCommand('open settings'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return { current, card: !!document.querySelector('#peekCard:not([hidden]), .peek') }

steps.why: It shows a card, the screen stays
